packet.source_core: Finite gauge-invariant polynomial combinations of SU(2) matrix coefficients, retaining edge order, representation labels and contraction witnesses.
packet.evaluation: Actual smooth gauge-invariant function in L2(SU(2)^7), quotienting exact zero evaluations; complete by normalized Haar norm.
packet.detector: Left-invariant link derivatives in a covariant edge-Lie-indexed L2 target; individual components are not scalar gauge invariants. The squared norm descends.
packet.continuation: H_lambda preserves the polynomial core algebraically; its self-adjoint closure defines the semigroup. No unrelated path-word cost is used.
packet.source_to_physical: Evaluation intertwines the declared differential/product operations; zero smooth evaluations have zero derivatives. The gauge-averaged Peter-Weyl polynomial core is dense.
packet.not_claimed: A universal higher-identity certificate, physical continuum reconstruction, or magnetic-vacuum-faithful detector.

electric_theorem.spectrum_rule: Spin networks have eigenvalue kappa*sum_e j_e(j_e+1).
electric_theorem.support_constraint: A gauge-invariant nonconstant spin network has no degree-one vertex in its nontrivial-representation support, so its support contains a cycle.
electric_theorem.sharp_state: Fundamental character on either plaquette, with four spin-1/2 edges.

magnetic_boundary.detector_mismatch: The raw electric derivative kills constants, not the deformed magnetic ground state. It cannot satisfy shifted-energy domination for all states at lambda>0.
magnetic_boundary.next_test: Construct a ground-state-relative detector and test whether its Poincare constant has graph/volume-uniform control.

scope: Written compact-group/spin-network theorems and exact rational differential/gauge controls. No reflection-positive four-dimensional Wilson family, volume-uniform magnetic gap or continuum theorem.
